sentences.en: I just want some souvenirs to remember this place by.
sentences.zh: 我只是想买些纪念品来记住这个地方。

sentences.en: The village is rife with dirty shops selling cheapjack souvenirs.
sentences.zh: 这个村庄到处都是卖劣质纪念品的小店铺。

sentences.en: Every time that the teacher travels, he gives us souvenirs.
sentences.zh: 每次出差回来，老师都会给我们带点纪念品。
